composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?' The agent should have asked the customer to sign the Scope of Appointment after the call, not during the call. This would have ensured the SOA was collected before the plan discussion.
composition.summary: The call was compliant with CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered prior to discussing any benefits, and the Scope of Appointment was collected before the plan discussion. No superlatives were used, and the call was scheduled for a follow-up review.
